desc: Raised above street level, this terrace cafe prepares a range of Indian & international dishes.
addr: 52, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Shivaji Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: The particular outlet might disappoint you. Lack of signages makes it uneasy to identify the entrance. There should be sufficient signages near the building entrance, lift. …

The café has a pleasant ambiance and is a nice place to relax. The coffee was decent, and the food was okay. Service was polite but a bit slow . The table covers were very dirty . Cold coffees were too sweet. Couldn't enjoy.
Overall, it's a good spot for a casual visit.
